answers.why: The congregation came from Israel to celebrate in Jerusalem.
Judah is the territory where the rejoicing residents dwelt.
All Israel present went out together to destroy idols.
Judah is the territory from which the altars were removed.
Benjamin names a tribal territory where the altars were destroyed.
Ephraim names a tribal territory where the religious sites were destroyed.
Manasseh names a tribal territory included in the destruction of altars.
Judah's descendants living in its cities brought tithes.
Israel is explicitly called the LORD's people.
Hezekiah carried out these arrangements throughout Judah's territory.
Sennacherib entered Judah's territory and besieged its fortified cities.
All Judah in Jerusalem received Sennacherib's message.
Hezekiah commanded Judah's people to worship before one altar.
The God of Israel is described as the God who delivers his people.
Wrath threatened Judah and Jerusalem because of Hezekiah's pride.
Israel names the kingdom whose kings are recorded alongside Judah's.
All Judah joined Jerusalem's inhabitants in honoring Hezekiah at his death.
